caption: Temple of Concordia, Agrigento
composition: Floodlit Doric temple in the Valley of the Temples at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The temple is seen from below its ridge, the floodlit Doric columns glowing gold against the night. The long colonnade runs across the center and right of the frame above its stepped stone base, with rocky scrub in the immediate foreground. To the left the lights of Agrigento scatter across the dark valley. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 05:10 Europe/Rome: full night, the temple artificially lit under a dark sky.
